<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope) {
	var c = this;

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// INITIAL STATE
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	c.data.calc                  = {};
	c.data.submitted             = false;
	c.data.returnedSysId         = '';
	c.data.returnComments        = '';
	c.data.isResubmit            = false;
	c.data.submitting            = false;
	c.data.saving                = false;
	c.data.searchError           = '';
	c.data.submitError           = '';
	c.data.searchTerm            = '';
	c.data.searchResults         = [];
	c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = '';
	c.data.sites                 = [];
	c.data.sitesCount            = 0;
	c.data.sitesTotalRequested   = 0;
	c.data.sitesValidationError  = '';
	c.data.agingTable            = [];

	// ── Autocomplete ────────────────────────────────────────────
	c.data.suggestions           = [];
	c.data.suggestionIndex       = -1;
	c.data.suggestionSelected    = false;
	c.data.suggestionTimer       = null;

	// ── Trade row ───────────────────────────────────────────────
	c.data.selectedTradeRow      = null;

	// ── Upload ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
	c.data.uploadedFiles         = [];
	c.data.uploadError           = '';
	c.data.uploadDragOver        = false;

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// SEARCH & AUTOCOMPLETE
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.onSearchChange = function() {
		c.data.searchResults         = [];
		c.data.agingTable            = [];
		c.data.searchError           = '';
		c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = '';
		c.data.suggestionSelected    = false;
		c.data.suggestionIndex       = -1;
		c.data.selectedTradeRow      = null;
		c.clearCustomerData();

		var term = (c.data.searchTerm || '').trim();
		if (term.length < 3) {
			c.data.suggestions = [];
			return;
		}

		if (c.data.suggestionTimer) clearTimeout(c.data.suggestionTimer);
		c.data.suggestionTimer = setTimeout(function() {
			c.fetchSuggestions(term);
		}, 300);
	};

	c.fetchSuggestions = function(term) {
		c.server.get({ action: 'searchCustomers', searchTerm: term })
			.then(function(r) {
				c.data.suggestions = (r.data.customers && r.data.customers.length > 0)
					? r.data.customers.slice(0, 8)
					: [];
				$scope.$apply();
			});
	};

	c.pickSuggestion = function(s) {
		c.data.searchTerm         = s.pan || s.customer_code_sap;
		c.data.suggestions        = [];
		c.data.suggestionSelected = true;
		c.searchCustomers();
	};

	c.onSearchKeydown = function(evt) {
		var len = c.data.suggestions.length;
		if (len === 0) return;

		if (evt.keyCode === 40) {                          // Arrow Down
			evt.preventDefault();
			c.data.suggestionIndex = Math.min(c.data.suggestionIndex + 1, len - 1);
		} else if (evt.keyCode === 38) {                   // Arrow Up
			evt.preventDefault();
			c.data.suggestionIndex = Math.max(c.data.suggestionIndex - 1, -1);
		} else if (evt.keyCode === 13) {                   // Enter
			evt.preventDefault();
			if (c.data.suggestionIndex >= 0) {
				c.pickSuggestion(c.data.suggestions[c.data.suggestionIndex]);
			} else {
				c.searchCustomers();
			}
		} else if (evt.keyCode === 27) {                   // Escape
			c.data.suggestions     = [];
			c.data.suggestionIndex = -1;
		}
	};

	c.searchCustomers = function() {
		var term = (c.data.searchTerm || '').trim();
		if (term.length < 3) {
			c.data.searchError = 'Enter at least 3 characters to search';
			return;
		}

		c.data.searchError           = '';
		c.data.searchResults         = [];
		c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = '';
		c.data.selectedTradeRow      = null;
		c.data.suggestions           = [];
		c.clearCustomerData();

		c.server.get({ action: 'searchCustomers', searchTerm: term })
			.then(function(r) {
				if (r.data.customers && r.data.customers.length > 0) {
c.data.searchResults = r.data.customers;

c.loadPanTableCredits();
				} else {
					c.data.searchResults = [];
					c.data.searchError   = 'No customers found';
				}
			});
	};
	
	// ── PAN TABLE CREDIT FETCH ──
c.loadPanTableCredits = function() {

    if (!c.data.searchResults || c.data.searchResults.length === 0)
        return;

    var totalPanCL = 0;

    c.data.searchResults.forEach(function(cust) {

        c.server.get({
            action: 'getCreditLimit',
            customer_code: cust.customer_code_sap
        }).then(function(res) {

            var credit = parseFloat(res.data.credit) || 0;

            // LIVE credit for top table
            cust.live_credit = credit;

            // PAN Level CL
            totalPanCL += credit;

            c.data.panlevelCL = totalPanCL;
        });
    });
};

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// CUSTOMER SELECTION
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.selectCustomer = function(cust) {
		if (!cust.is_my_customer) {
			alert('You can only select customers assigned to you.');
			return;
		}

		// Clicking the same row again — do nothing
		if (c.data.selectedCustomerSysId === cust.sys_id) return;

		// ── Populate customer fields ────────────────────────────
		c.data.selectedCustomerSysId = cust.sys_id;
		c.data.customerSysId         = cust.sys_id;
		c.data.customerName          = cust.customer_name;
		c.data.customerType          = cust.customer_type;
		c.data.segment               = cust.segment;
		c.data.depot                 = cust.depot;
		c.data.zone                  = cust.zone;
		c.data.region                = cust.region;
		c.data.pan                   = cust.pan;
		c.data.cg2Code               = cust.cg2_code;
		c.data.constitution          = cust.constitution;
		c.data.firstOrderDateStr = cust.first_order_date || '';
		c.data.isListed              = cust.is_listed;
		c.data.agingTable            = cust.aging_table || [];
		c.data.vintageDays           = cust.vintage_days;
		c.data.currentLimit          = cust.current_credit_limit / 100000;
		c.data.avgMonthlySales       = cust.avg_monthly_sales;
		c.data.orderRate             = cust.order_rate || 7000;
		c.data.outstanding           = cust.outstanding || 0;
		c.data.panLevelSD            = cust.pan_level_sd || 0;
	//	c.data.panlevelCL            = cust.pan_level_cl || 0;
		c.data.activeSD              = cust.customer_type === 'Trade' ? (cust.current_sd || 0) : 0;

		// ── Build trade row ─────────────────────────────────────
if (cust.customer_type === 'Trade') {

    c.data.selectedTradeRow = {
        customer_code:        cust.customer_code_sap,
        customer_sys_id:      cust.sys_id,
        active_sd:            cust.current_sd || 0,
        current_limit:        cust.current_credit_limit || 0,
        outstanding:          cust.outstanding || 0,
        requested_additional: 0,
        requested_nod:        0,
        total_requested:      cust.current_credit_limit || 0
    };

    // ]]>🔥<![CDATA[ LIVE SOAP CREDIT LIMIT
    c.server.get({
        action: 'getCreditLimit',
        customer_code: cust.customer_code_sap
    }).then(function(response) {

        var credit = parseFloat(response.data.credit) || 0;

        // Customer strip
        c.data.currentLimit = credit / 100000;

        // Trade row
        c.data.selectedTradeRow.current_limit = credit;
        c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested = credit;
    });

    c.data.requestedLimit = 0;
    c.data.calc = {};

} else {
    c.data.selectedTradeRow = null;
}

		// ── Load sites for Non-Trade ────────────────────────────
		if (cust.customer_type === 'Non-Trade') {
			c.loadSites(cust.sys_id, cust.pan);
		}

		if (c.data.requestedLimit > 0) c.recalculate();
	};

	
	
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// TRADE CALCULATION
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.calculateSingleTrade = function() {
		if (!c.data.selectedTradeRow) return;

		var current = parseFloat(c.data.selectedTradeRow.current_limit) || 0;
		var raw     = c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional;

		// Empty input — reset
if (raw === '' || raw === null || raw === undefined || raw == 0) {

    c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional = 0;
    c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional_display = '';

    c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested = current;

    // IMPORTANT
    c.data.requestedLimit = 0;
    c.data.calc = null;

    return;
}

		var total = current + parseFloat(raw);

		if (total < 0) {
			alert('Total Limit Requested cannot be negative');
			c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional = 0;
			c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested      = current;
			c.data.requestedLimit                        = current;
			return;
		}

		c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested = total;
		c.data.requestedLimit                   = total;
		c.data.requestedNod = parseFloat(c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_nod) || 0;

		if (total > 0) {
			c.recalculate();
		} else {
			c.data.calc = {};
		}
	};

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// NON-TRADE SITES
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.loadSites = function(customerSysId, pan) {
		c.server.get({ action: 'loadSites', customerSysId: customerSysId, pan: pan })
			.then(function(r) {
				if (r.data.sites && r.data.sites.length > 0) {
					c.data.sites      = r.data.sites;
					c.data.sitesCount = r.data.sites.length;
					c.recalculateSites();
				} else {
					c.data.sites      = [];
					c.data.sitesCount = 0;
				}
			});
	};

	c.recalculateSites = function() {
		if (!c.data.sites || c.data.sites.length === 0) {
			c.data.sitesTotalRequested = 0;
			c.data.sitesCount          = 0;
			return;
		}
		var total = 0, count = 0;
		c.data.sites.forEach(function(site) {
			var req = parseFloat(site.requested_limit) || 0;
			if (req > 0) { total += req; count++; }
		});
		c.data.sitesTotalRequested  = total / 100000;
		c.data.sitesCount           = count;
		c.data.sitesValidationError = (c.data.sitesTotalRequested === 0)
			? 'All requested credit must be allocated to sites. Total cannot be 0.'
			: '';
		c.data.requestedLimit = total;
		c.recalculate();
	};

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// LIVE CALCULATION
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.recalculate = function() {
		if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade') return;

		var req = parseFloat(c.data.requestedLimit) || 0;
		if (req <= 0 || !c.data.customerSysId) {
			c.data.calc = {};
			return;
		}

c.server.get({
            action:             'calculate',
            customerType:       c.data.customerType || 'Trade',
            customerSysId:      c.data.customerSysId,
            requestedLimit:     req,
            activeSD:           parseFloat(c.data.activeSD)        || 0,
            outstanding:        parseFloat(c.data.outstanding)     || 0,
            avgMonthlySales:    parseFloat(c.data.avgMonthlySales) || 0,
            salesLastMonth:     parseFloat(c.data.salesLastMonth)  || 0,
            salesPrevMonth:     parseFloat(c.data.salesPrevMonth)  || 0,
            segment:            c.data.segment   || 'Cement',
            cg2Code:            c.data.cg2Code   || '',
            vintageDays:        parseInt(c.data.vintageDays)       || 0,
            firstOrderDateStr:  c.data.firstOrderDateStr           || '',
            requestedNod:       parseFloat(c.data.requestedNod)    || 0
        }).then(function(r) {
			if (r.data.calc) {
				c.data.calc = angular.copy(r.data.calc);
			}
		});
	};

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// FILE UPLOAD
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.triggerFileInput = function() {
		document.getElementById('clmFileInput').click();
	};

	c.onFilesSelected = function(fileList) {
		c.data.uploadError = '';
		Array.prototype.slice.call(fileList).forEach(function(file) {
			c.addFile(file);
		});
		document.getElementById('clmFileInput').value = '';
		$scope.$apply();
	};

	c.addFile = function(file) {
		var MAX_FILES    = 5;
		var MAX_SIZE_MB  = 5;
		var ALLOWED_EXTS = ['pdf', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'xlsx', 'xls', 'doc', 'docx'];

		if (c.data.uploadedFiles.length >= MAX_FILES) {
			c.data.uploadError = 'Maximum ' + MAX_FILES + ' files allowed.';
			return;
		}

		var ext = file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
		if (ALLOWED_EXTS.indexOf(ext) === -1) {
			c.data.uploadError = '"' + file.name + '" is not an allowed file type.';
			return;
		}

		if (file.size > MAX_SIZE_MB * 1024 * 1024) {
			c.data.uploadError = '"' + file.name + '" exceeds the ' + MAX_SIZE_MB + 'MB limit.';
			return;
		}

		var isDup = c.data.uploadedFiles.some(function(f) {
			return f.name === file.name && f.size === file.size;
		});
		if (isDup) {
			c.data.uploadError = '"' + file.name + '" is already attached.';
			return;
		}

		var entry = { name: file.name, size: file.size, uploading: true, sysId: null, error: null };
		c.data.uploadedFiles.push(entry);
		c.uploadFile(file, entry);
	};

	c.uploadFile = function(file, entry) {
		var reader = new FileReader();
		reader.onload = function(e) {
			var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1];
			c.server.get({
				action:      'uploadAttachment',
				fileName:    file.name,
				contentType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
				base64Data:  base64
			}).then(function(r) {
				entry.uploading = false;
				entry.sysId     = r.data.sysId  || null;
				entry.error     = r.data.sysId  ? null : (r.data.error || 'Upload failed');
				$scope.$apply();
			});
		};
		reader.readAsDataURL(file);
	};

	c.removeFile = function(index) {
		var file = c.data.uploadedFiles[index];
		if (file.sysId) {
			c.server.get({ action: 'deleteAttachment', sysId: file.sysId });
		}
		c.data.uploadedFiles.splice(index, 1);
		c.data.uploadError = '';
	};

	c.getFileIcon = function(name) {
		var ext = (name || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
		var map = {
			pdf: ']]>📄<![CDATA[', jpg: ']]>🖼<![CDATA[️', jpeg: ']]>🖼<![CDATA[️', png: ']]>🖼<![CDATA[️',
			xlsx: ']]>📊<![CDATA[', xls: ']]>📊<![CDATA[', doc: ']]>📝<![CDATA[', docx: ']]>📝<![CDATA['
		};
		return map[ext] || ']]>📎<![CDATA[';
	};
	
	c.formatIndianCurrency = function(value) {

    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '')
        return '0';

    value = parseFloat(value);

    return value.toLocaleString('en-IN', {
        maximumFractionDigits: 0
    });
};
c.onRequestedLimitChange = function() {

    var val = c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional_display || '';

    // remove commas
    val = val.toString().replace(/,/g, '');

    // keep numeric only
    val = val.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');

    // store actual number
    c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional = parseInt(val || 0);

    // display indian format
    c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional_display =
        c.formatIndianCurrency(c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional);

    // recalculate
    c.calculateSingleTrade();
};
	c.formatFileSize = function(bytes) {
		if (!bytes) return '0 B';
		if (bytes < 1024)        return bytes + ' B';
		if (bytes < 1048576)     return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
		return (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(2) + ' MB';
	};

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// SAVE DRAFT
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.saveDraft = function() {
		c.data.saving = true;
		c.server.get({ action: 'saveDraft', form: c.buildPayload() })
			.then(function(r) {
				c.data.saving        = false;
				c.data.draftSysId    = r.data.sysId;
				c.data.requestNumber = r.data.number;
			});
	};

	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	// SUBMIT
	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	c.submit = function() {
		c.data.submitError = '';

		// 1. Customer selected
		if (!c.data.selectedCustomerSysId) {
			c.data.submitError = 'Please select a customer.';
			return;
		}

		// 2. Trade — additional limit required
		if (c.data.customerType === 'Trade') {
			if (!c.data.selectedTradeRow) {
				c.data.submitError = 'Please select a customer first.';
				return;
			}
			if ((parseFloat(c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional) || 0) <= 0) {
				c.data.submitError = 'Please enter the additional limit amount to request.';
				return;
			}
		}

		// 3. Business justification
		if (!c.data.justification || c.data.justification.trim().length < 20) {
			c.data.submitError = 'Business justification must be at least 20 characters.';
			return;
		}

		// 4. Deviation justification
		if (c.data.calc && c.data.calc.isDeviation) {
			if (!c.data.deviationJustification || c.data.deviationJustification.trim().length < 20) {
				c.data.submitError = 'Deviation justification is required (min 20 characters).';
				return;
			}
		}

		// 5. Non-Trade site allocation

    var CEMENT = {

        'MD':      'TSH → RHM → ZHM → NSH → NSH_CCH → CMO → CMO_CFO → MD'
    };

    // ── RMC hierarchy ─────────────────────────────────────────
    var RMC = {
        'TSM':             'TSM',
        'RH_CH_RMC':       'TSM → RH_CH_RMC',
        'ZH_RMC':          'TSM → RH_CH_RMC → ZH_RMC',
        'HEAD_RMC':        'TSM → RH_CH_RMC → ZH_RMC → HEAD_RMC',

        'BH':              'TSM → RH_CH_RMC → ZH_RMC → HEAD_RMC → HEAD_KEY_CH_RMC → HEAD_KEY_CCH → BH',
        'BH_CFO':          'TSM → RH_CH_RMC → ZH_RMC → HEAD_RMC → HEAD_KEY_CH_RMC → HEAD_KEY_CCH → BH → BH_CFO',
        'MD':              'TSM → RH_CH_RMC → ZH_RMC → HEAD_RMC → HEAD_KEY_CH_RMC → HEAD_KEY_CCH → BH → BH_CFO → MD'
    };

    // ── BPD hierarchy ─────────────────────────────────────────
    var BPD = {
        'TSH_BPD':  'TSH_BPD',
        'ZH_BPD':   'TSH_BPD → ZH_BPD',
        'HSBPD':    'TSH_BPD → ZH_BPD → HSBPD',

        'MD':       'TSH_BPD → ZH_BPD → HSBPD → HBPD → CCH_HBPD → BH → CFO → MD'
    };

    // ── Pick correct map based on segment ─────────────────────
    var map;
    if (seg === 'RMC') {
        map = RMC;
    } else if (seg === 'BPD') {
        map = BPD;
    } else {
        map = CEMENT; // default: Cement
    }

    return map[role] || role;

-->

<div class="clm-widget">

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       HEADER
  ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="clm-header">
    <div class="clm-header-left">
      <div class="clm-title">
        <span ng-if="!c.data.customerType || c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">Trade Customer</span>
        <span ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade'">Non-Trade Customer</span>
        <span ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Key'">Key Customer</span>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-subtitle">Credit Limit Request</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-header-right" ng-if="c.data.requestNumber">
      <div class="clm-request-badge">{{c.data.requestNumber}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      <div class="clm-alert-body">

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 1: CUSTOMER SEARCH
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">1</span> Customer Search
      </div>

      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Search by PAN or Customer Code <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <div class="clm-search-autocomplete">
            <div class="clm-input-group">
              <input type="text"
                     ng-model="c.data.searchTerm"
                     ng-change="c.onSearchChange()"
                     ng-keydown="c.onSearchKeydown($event)"
                     placeholder="Enter PAN (e.g., ABCDE1234Z) or Customer Code"
                     class="clm-input"
                     autocomplete="off"
                     required />
              <button type="button"
                      class="clm-input-btn"
                      ng-click="c.searchCustomers()"
                      ng-disabled="!c.data.searchTerm || c.data.searchTerm.length < 3">
                Search

            </div>

            <!-- SUGGESTIONS DROPDOWN -->
            <div class="clm-suggestions-dropdown"
                 ng-if="c.data.suggestions.length > 0 && !c.data.suggestionSelected">
              <div ng-repeat="s in c.data.suggestions track by $index"
                   class="clm-suggestion-item"
                   ng-class="{'clm-suggestion-active': c.data.suggestionIndex == $index}"
                   ng-mousedown="c.pickSuggestion(s)">
                <span class="clm-suggestion-icon">]]>🔍<![CDATA[</span>
                <div class="clm-suggestion-text">
                  <span class="clm-suggestion-name">{{s.customer_name}}</span>

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="clm-field-hint" ng-if="c.data.searchTerm && c.data.searchTerm.length < 3">
            Enter at least 3 characters to search
          </div>
          <div class="clm-field-msg clm-error" ng-if="c.data.searchError">
            {{c.data.searchError}}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- SEARCH RESULTS TABLE -->
      <div class="clm-search-results" ng-if="c.data.searchResults.length > 0">
        <div class="clm-search-results-title">
          Found {{c.data.searchResults.length}} customer(s)
          <span ng-if="c.data.searchResults[0].pan">
            for PAN / Code: <strong>{{c.data.searchTerm | uppercase}}</strong>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-pan-table-wrapper">
          <table class="clm-pan-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="width:32px;"></th>
                <th>Customer Name</th>
                <th>Customer Code</th>
                <th>Segment</th>
                <th>Depot</th>
                <th>Region</th>
                <th>Zone</th>
                <th>Active SD</th>
                <th>Active Credit Limit</th>
                <th>Outstanding</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr ng-repeat="cust in c.data.searchResults"
                  ng-click="c.selectCustomer(cust)"
                  ng-class="{
                    'clm-pan-row-selected': c.data.selectedCustomerSysId == cust.sys_id,
                    'clm-pan-row-disabled': !cust.is_my_customer
                  }"
                  class="clm-pan-row">
                <td>
                  <span ng-if="c.data.selectedCustomerSysId == cust.sys_id"
                        class="clm-row-check">✓</span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div class="clm-pan-name">{{cust.customer_name}}</div>
                  <div class="clm-pan-type"
                       ng-class="{
                         'clm-type-trade':    cust.customer_type == 'Trade',
                         'clm-type-nontrade': cust.customer_type == 'Non-Trade',
                         'clm-type-key':      cust.customer_type == 'Key'
                       }">{{cust.customer_type}}</div>
                </td>
                <td><strong>{{cust.customer_code_sap}}</strong></td>
                <td>
                  <span class="clm-search-card-badge"
                        ng-class="{
                          'clm-badge-cement': cust.segment == 'Cement',
                          'clm-badge-rmc':    cust.segment == 'RMC',
                          'clm-badge-bpd':    cust.segment == 'BPD'
                        }">{{cust.segment}}</span>
                </td>
                <td><strong>{{cust.depot}}</strong></td>
                <td><strong>{{cust.region}}</strong></td>
                <td><strong>{{cust.zone}}</strong></td>
                <td class="clm-pan-num">₹{{cust.current_sd / 100000 | number:2}}L</td>
                <td class="clm-pan-num">₹{{(cust.live_credit || 0) / 100000 | number:2}}L</td>
                <td class="clm-pan-num">₹{{cust.outstanding / 100000 | number:2}}L</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-pan-hint">Click a row to select the customer and proceed</div>
      </div>

      <!-- CUSTOMER STRIP (after selection) -->
      <div class="clm-customer-strip"
           ng-if="c.data.customerName && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Customer</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.customerName}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Type</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value"
                ng-class="{
                  'clm-type-trade':    c.data.customerType == 'Trade',
                  'clm-type-nontrade': c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade',
                  'clm-type-key':      c.data.customerType == 'Key'
                }">
            {{c.data.customerType || '—'}}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Segment</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.segment || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Depot</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.depot || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Zone</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.zone || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Region</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.region || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">PAN</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.pan || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">CG2 Code</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.cg2Code || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Current Credit Limit</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">₹{{c.data.currentLimit | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">PAN Level SD</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">₹{{(c.data.panLevelSD || 0) / 100000 | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">PAN Level CL</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">₹{{(c.data.panlevelCL || 0) / 100000 | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div><!-- /SECTION 1 -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         AGING TABLE
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="c.data.selectedCustomerSysId && c.data.agingTable && c.data.agingTable.length > 0">
      <div class="clm-section-title">6-Month Aging Breakdown</div>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto;">
        <table class="clm-aging-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Month</th>
              <th>0-30</th>
              <th>31-45</th>
              <th>46-60</th>
              <th>61-75</th>
              <th>76-90</th>
              <th>91-120</th>
              <th>>120</th>
              <th>Total</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr ng-repeat="row in c.data.agingTable">
              <td>{{row.month}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b0_30   | number}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b31_45  | number}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b46_60  | number}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b61_75  | number}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b76_90  | number}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b91_120 | number}}</td>
              <td>{{row.b120   | number}}</td>
              <td><strong>{{row.total | number}}</strong></td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div><!-- /AGING TABLE -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 2A: TRADE — Credit Limit & SD
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade' && c.data.selectedTradeRow">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">2</span> Customer Limit Details
      </div>

      <div class="clm-sites-table">
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="clm-sites-table-header">
          <div class="clm-sites-col-site">Customer Code</div>
          <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">Active SD</div>
          <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">Current Credit Limit</div>
          <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding">Outstanding</div>
          <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">Request Additional Limit</div>
      <!--    <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">Requested NOD (Days)</div>   -->
          <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">Total Limit Requested</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Row -->
        <div class="clm-sites-table-row">
          <div class="clm-sites-col-site">{{c.data.selectedTradeRow.customer_code}}</div>
       <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">
₹{{c.formatIndianCurrency(c.data.selectedTradeRow.active_sd)}}
</div>

<div class="clm-sites-col-limit">
₹{{c.formatIndianCurrency(c.data.selectedTradeRow.current_limit)}}
</div>

<div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding">
₹{{c.formatIndianCurrency(c.data.selectedTradeRow.outstanding)}}
</div>
      <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
  <input type="text"
         ng-model="c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional_display"
         ng-change="c.onRequestedLimitChange()"
         class="clm-sites-input"
         placeholder="0" />
</div>
  <!--        <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
            <input type="number"
                   ng-model="c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_nod"
                   ng-change="c.calculateSingleTrade()"
                   class="clm-sites-input"
                   min="0" />
          </div>  -->
        <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
₹{{c.formatIndianCurrency(c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested)}}
</div>

        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Total -->
      <div class="clm-sites-totals-row">
        <div><strong>Total</strong></div>
        <div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div>
<div>
  <strong>₹{{c.formatIndianCurrency(c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested || 0)}}</strong>
</div>      </div>
    </div><!-- /SECTION 2A -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 2B: NON-TRADE — Multi-Site Allocation
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade' && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">2</span> Site-Wise Credit Limit Request
      </div>

      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-warning">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">⚠</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>No Orphan Limit Rule</strong><br>
          All requested credit must be allocated to specific sites. Parent-level limits are not allowed.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clm-sites-panel">
        <div class="clm-sites-header">
          <span class="clm-sites-icon">]]>📍<![CDATA[</span> Sites Under Your Jurisdiction
        </div>

        <div class="clm-sites-table">
          <div class="clm-sites-table-header">
            <div class="clm-sites-col-depot">Depot</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-site">Site Code</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-location">Location</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">Current Limit</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding">Outstanding</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-project">Project Potential (₹L)</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-volume">Monthly Volume (₹L)</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">Requested Limit (₹L)</div>
          </div>

          <div ng-repeat="site in c.data.sites" class="clm-sites-table-row">
            <div class="clm-sites-col-depot">{{site.depot}}</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-site"><strong>{{site.site_code}}</strong></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-location">{{site.location}}</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-limit">₹{{site.current_limit / 100000 | number:2}}L</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding">₹{{site.outstanding / 100000 | number:2}}L</div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-project">
              <input type="number"
                     ng-model="site.project_potential"
                     class="clm-sites-input"
                     min="0" placeholder="0" />
            </div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-volume">
              <input type="number"
                     ng-model="site.monthly_volume"
                     class="clm-sites-input"
                     min="0" placeholder="0" />
            </div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
              <input type="number"
                     ng-model="site.requested_limit"
                     ng-change="c.recalculateSites()"
                     class="clm-sites-input clm-sites-input-highlight"
                     min="0" placeholder="0" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="clm-sites-totals-row">
            <div class="clm-sites-col-depot"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-site"><strong>Total</strong></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-location"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-limit"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-outstanding"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-project"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-volume"></div>
            <div class="clm-sites-col-requested">
              <strong>₹{{c.data.sitesTotalRequested | number:2}}L</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Consolidated Summary -->
      <div class="clm-consolidated-summary">
        <div class="clm-consolidated-title">]]>📊<![CDATA[ Consolidated Request Summary</div>
        <div class="clm-consolidated-grid">
          <div class="clm-consolidated-item">
            <div class="clm-consolidated-label">Number of Sites Selected:</div>
            <div class="clm-consolidated-value">{{c.data.sitesCount}}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-consolidated-item clm-consolidated-item-highlight">
            <div class="clm-consolidated-label">Total Requested Limit:</div>
            <div class="clm-consolidated-value">₹{{c.data.sitesTotalRequested | number:2}}L</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Approval Routing Preview -->
      <div class="clm-approval-preview" ng-if="c.data.sitesTotalRequested > 0">
        <div class="clm-approval-title">]]>🔄<![CDATA[ Approval Routing Preview</div>
        <div class="clm-approval-body">
          Based on Total Request: <strong>₹{{c.data.sitesTotalRequested | number:2}}L</strong>
          <div class="clm-approval-flow">
            <span class="clm-approval-role">TSH</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-role clm-approval-role-highlight">RHM</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-arrow">→</span>
            <span class="clm-approval-role">ZHO</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-approval-note">* Routing determined by consolidated request amount</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Site Validation Error -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.sitesValidationError">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">✗</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">{{c.data.sitesValidationError}}</div>
      </div>
    </div><!-- /SECTION 2B -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         LIVE CALCULATION PANEL — TRADE
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-calc-panel"
         ng-if="!c.data.submitted 
&& c.data.customerType == 'Trade'
&& c.data.activeSD > 0
&& c.data.requestedLimit > 0
&& c.data.calc">
      <div class="clm-calc-title">Live Calculation</div>
      <div class="clm-calc-grid">
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">System Multiplier</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">{{c.data.calc.multiplier || '—'}}x</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Max Allowable</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.maxAllowable | number:2}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">SD × Multiplier</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Net Exposure</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.netExposure | number:2}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Requested − SD</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Implied Multiplier</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="c.data.calc.isDeviation ? 'clm-val-danger' : 'clm-val-ok'">
            {{c.data.calc.impliedMult | number:2}}x
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Requested ÷ SD</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Approver</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">{{c.data.calc.approverRole || '—'}}</div>
          <div ng-if="c.data.calc.escalated"
               style="color:red; font-size:12px; margin-top:4px;">↑ Escalated</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub" ng-if="c.data.calc.approverRole">
            {{c.data.calc.approvalFlow || '—'}}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Deviation alert — inside calc panel -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">⚠</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>Deviation</strong> — Implied {{c.data.calc.impliedMult | number:2}}x
          exceeds system {{c.data.calc.multiplier}}x. Higher approval required.
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Within limits alert — inside calc panel -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-success"
           ng-if="c.data.requestedLimit > 0 && c.data.calc.impliedMult && !c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        ✓ Within Limits — Routes to {{c.data.calc.approverRole}}
      </div>
    </div><!-- /CALC PANEL -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 3: BUSINESS JUSTIFICATION
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="!c.data.submitted && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">3</span> Business Justification <span class="req">*</span>
      </div>
      <textarea ng-model="c.data.justification"

                rows="4"

        <label style="font-weight:600; color:#c0392b">

          <small>(Required — request exceeds safe limit)</small>
        </label>
        <textarea ng-model="c.data.deviationJustification"
                  class="clm-textarea clm-textarea-danger"

                  ng-required="c.data.calc.isDeviation"></textarea>

    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="!c.data.submitted && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">

        <span class="clm-ms-badge">Optional</span>

      <div class="clm-upload-area"
           ng-class="{'clm-upload-area-active': c.data.uploadDragOver}"
           ng-click="c.triggerFileInput()">
        <div class="clm-upload-icon">]]>📎<![CDATA[</div>
        <div class="clm-upload-text">
          <strong>Click to browse</strong> or drag & drop files here
        </div>
        <div class="clm-upload-hint">
          Accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, XLSX, DOC, DOCX  | 
          Max 5MB per file  |  Up to 5 files
        </div>
        <input type="file"
               id="clmFileInput"
               multiple
               accept=".pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.xlsx,.xls,.doc,.docx"
               style="display:none"
               onchange="angular.element(this).scope().c.onFilesSelected(this.files)" />
      </div>

      <!-- File List -->
      <div class="clm-file-list"
           ng-if="c.data.uploadedFiles && c.data.uploadedFiles.length > 0">
        <div class="clm-file-list-title">
          Attached Files ({{c.data.uploadedFiles.length}}/5)
        </div>
        <div class="clm-file-row"
             ng-repeat="file in c.data.uploadedFiles track by $index">
          <span class="clm-file-icon">{{c.getFileIcon(file.name)}}</span>
          <div class="clm-file-info">
            <span class="clm-file-name">{{file.name}}</span>
            <span class="clm-file-size">{{c.formatFileSize(file.size)}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-file-status">
            <span ng-if="file.uploading"               class="clm-file-uploading">⏳ Uploading...</span>
            <span ng-if="file.sysId && !file.uploading" class="clm-file-done">✓ Uploaded</span>
            <span ng-if="file.error"                    class="clm-file-error">✗ {{file.error}}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button"
                  class="clm-file-remove"
                  ng-click="c.removeFile($index)"
                  title="Remove file">✕</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Upload Error -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger"
           ng-if="c.data.uploadError"
           style="margin-top:12px">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">✗</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">{{c.data.uploadError}}</div>
      </div>
    </div><!-- /SECTION 4 -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SUBMIT ERROR
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger"
         ng-if="c.data.submitError"
         style="margin:0; border-radius:0; border-top:1px solid #f5b7b1;">
      <div class="clm-alert-icon">✗</div>
      <div class="clm-alert-body">{{c.data.submitError}}</div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         ACTIONS
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-actions"
         ng-if="!c.data.submitted && c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
      <button type="button"
              class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline"
              ng-click="c.saveDraft()"
              ng-disabled="c.data.saving">
        {{c.data.saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Draft'}}
      </button>
      <button type="button"
              class="clm-btn clm-btn-primary"
              ng-click="c.submit()"
              ng-disabled="c.data.submitting || !c.data.selectedCustomerSysId">
        {{c.data.submitting ? 'Submitting...' : (c.data.returnedSysId ? 'Resubmit for Approval' : 'Submit for Approval')}}
      </button>
    </div><!-- /ACTIONS -->

  </form>
</div><!-- /clm-widget -->]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
